---
title: "SPICE Book Club"
---

A seven-session, biweekly reading group on the NAIF SPICE toolkit for LASP developers,
using MAVEN as the running example. See the [Course Plan](course-plan.qmd) for readings,
background topics and notebooks for each session.

| # | Theme | Slides | Notebook |
|---|-------|--------|----------|
| 1 | SPICE architecture and kernels | [Session 1](slides/01_kernels.qmd) | [01_kernels_and_ids](https://colab.research.google.com/github/lasp/spice-tutorials/blob/main/notebooks/01_kernels_and_ids.ipynb) |
| 2 | Time | [Session 2: Time](slides/02_time.qmd) | *coming soon* |
| 3 | Ephemerides (SPK) | *coming soon* | *coming soon* |
| 4 | Rotations and reference frames | *coming soon* | *coming soon* |
| 5 | Attitude and instruments (CK, FK, IK) | *coming soon* | *coming soon* |
| 6 | Derived geometry and event finding | *coming soon* | *coming soon* |
| 7 | Making kernels (advanced, optional) | *coming soon* | *coming soon* |

Notebooks open in Google Colab (sign in with a Google account). To run without an account, use
[Binder](https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/lasp/spice-tutorials/main?labpath=notebooks), or clone the repo
and `pip install -r requirements.txt`.
